name: @carshenas/notifications
description: Buyers' notifications, shared by the web app and the worker (ADR-0026): every kind declared once, with its payload schema, event key, Farsi text and mute label, and the one helper producers write through; plus a development command, `pnpm notifications:sample`, that notifies an account of real recent price drops. TypeScript source, run as is by Next.js and by Node.
